# pi-ecosystem-mcap

> Independent analysis of Pi ecosystem market-cap framing at activation: confirmed vs speculation.

Machine index: [llms.txt](llms.txt)

## Quick rule
- Confirmed only if stated in official Pi/partner sources.
- Else → speculation.
- Pi is stated as primary; OUSD is complementary.
- "All converts to Pi" is not found as an official rule.
- No financial advice. Read-only.
